steps.npc: This passage leads to the lair of what your kind call the Alchemical Hydra. It is an ancient beast, the only one of its kind.
I am here to protect it. For protecting it will protect the balance. I make sure that only those who have permission can fight it.
Only Konar quo Maten can grant permission to fight the Alchemical Hydra. She will rarely grant this permission when the beast needs calming.

options.text: Do you have any of my items?
Do you have any of my items?

steps.player: Do you have any of my items?

steps.text: If the player has no items in Orrvor quo Maten's collection:

steps.npc: I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.

steps.text: If the player has items in Orrvor quo Maten's collection:

steps.npc: I do. I suppose you want them back.

steps.target: Orrvor quo Maten's Item Retrieval Service

attempting-to-kill-the-alchemical-hydra-.npc: Human! To attack that creature would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight it!

attempting-to-enter-the-alchemical-hydra.npc: I have some items of yours here human. I'd recommend you collect them before returning to the lair.

options.text: Enter the lair and risk losing those items.

steps.text: The player enters the Alchemical Hydra's lair.
